title: Complications of Diverticulitis of the Colon Diagram
author: Anpol42
caption: Medical illustration comparing uncomplicated colonic diverticulitis with complicated disease including pericolic abscess, perforation, fistula, and stricture.
alt_text: Anatomical diagram of the colon showing inflamed diverticula and potential complications.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates the clinical distinction between uncomplicated and complicated diverticulitis central to NASA CliFF-030 (CLIFF-030, p.1, p.6).
